text:
samir: Heads-up — provisioning work for new org 'NovaTech'. We need cross-cloud accounts + GPU quota increases across AWS (us-west-2), GCP (europe-west1), and Azure (southeast-asia). Quick checklist in this thread, please claim ownership for each cloud and network/billing items.

samir: Checklist (initial):
- Create accounts/projects, attach billing account.
- Request GPU quota increases (A100 primary, L4/A10 fallback).
- Network: subnets, NAT/GW sizing, peering between prod VPCs.
- IAM roles: platform-novatech-admin + limited-security roles.
- Tags: project=novatech, owner=platform, cost_center=ai-prod, env=prod.
- Verify limits: ENIs, VPN tunnels, Load Balancer quotas.
- Estimate monthly cost and recommend reserved vs on-demand split.

anya: I can own AWS side. I'll open quota requests for a100/p4 family and ENI/ELB limits. Anyone blocking specific instance family?

samir: Primary needs are A100 / p4d (prod inference) in us-west-2 and europe-west1. Secondary: L4/A10 for cheaper batch jobs. Also increase EBS GP3 IOPS and throughput caps for heavy sharded workloads.

alex: I'll take GCP. Plan: create project `nova-prod-eu`, enable Compute Engine and IAM, request accelerators increase (a100). Need billing account ID from finance. Also will request CPUs and regional internal IP quotas.

maria: Billing here — billing account ID: NOVATECH-BILL-001. Sharing secure access in the finance vault (link: https://vault.redwood.internal/secret/NOVATECH-BILL-001). Please set billing export to BigQuery (dataset: nova_billing_export).

samir: IAM note: create a role `roles/redwood.platform_novatech_admin` with scoped perms: compute.admin (limited to projects), iam.serviceAccounts.actAs for platform SA, logging.write. Security team wants read-only audit for security group changes. Use our standard role template: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/iam-templates#platform-admin

anya: AWS tickets opened:
- AWS-78901: increase p4d instance quota to 20 in us-west-2
- AWS-78902: ENI count increase to 200
- AWS-78903: Elastic Load Balancer LCU limit bumped

devops-bot: Created ticket AWS-78901. Assigned to infra-aws oncall. ETA: 48-72h.

alex: GCP request submitted: GCP-34222 (accelerators: A100 -> 15 in europe-west1). Payload I used:
```
{
  "quota_change": {
    "metric": "GPUS",
    "region": "europe-west1",
    "desired": 15,
    "notes": "NovaTech prod inference fleet; expected sustained usage"
  }
}
```

gcp-support: Received GCP-34222. Accelerator quota request looks good; expected processing time 3 business days. Please ensure project has billing enabled.

maria: Cost projection (very rough): if NovaTech runs 10 p4d nodes steady + burst L4, monthly delta ~ $48k USD. Recommend 60% reserved / 40% on-demand mix for first 6 months. I'll prepare a detailed sheet and send to Samir.

samir: Networking specifics: ensure NAT gateway capacity >= 10Gbps for prod VPCs, create transit peerings for cross-region control plane, reserve ephemeral IP pools for autoscaling. Also confirm Azure region has GPU SKUs available (eastasia / southeastasia).

anya: FYI AWS console note — some large GPU SKUs require account-level whitelisting for NVMe-backed AMIs. I'll check with aws-support.

aws-support: Noted. For p4d access we need to verify support case and instance family approval. We'll escalate once request is in.

alex: Terraform checklist I'll push to infra repo:
- terraform/google/project.tf (create project, link billing),
- terraform/google/quotas.tf (use google_project_service and quota requests where possible),
- tags module: set `project=novatech`, `cost_center=ai-prod`, `owner=platform`.

anya: Assigning ownership: AWS quotas (anya), GCP quotas (alex), IAM & role bindings (samir), Billing export & cost projection (maria), Networking peering (samir + netops).

samir: Great — I'll update the cross-cloud provisioning checklist with ticket IDs and estimated completion. Ping here when tickets resolve. :thumbsup:
